finalText:
Found it: `computeTotal` was subtracting the flat coupon (stored in USD) after converting the total to the target currency, so a $10 coupon became "10 EUR off" instead of "10 USD off". Fixed it in `src/services/pricing.js` to subtract flat coupons from the USD subtotal before conversion, leaving percent coupons applied after conversion as before.

All 5 tests pass now.
